description: The render core's Direct3D 12 adapter and its SDL3-D3D12 presentation bridge (RFC 0024) on Windows x86_64 PE, built with MinGW-w64 and verified under Wine with vkd3d-proton on the host GPU (the required lane, tools/render/d3d12_lane.py; X5 also runs under Wine by user decision 2026-10-07). Results prove the adapter against D3D12 as vkd3d-proton implements it, not against a Windows driver.

target.support_scope: Adapter, bridge and lab verification lane; no product (the portal and portal2 kiln profiles) composes the d3d12 device before R91.

runtime: vkd3d-proton (newest host Proton build, printed with every run)
host_toolchain.session: mutter --headless with a private D-Bus session (kiln's private-x11 display session): windows never reach the user's display

dxc.note: The Windows release's dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll are the adapter's runtime compiler (an import of the executable); the Linux release checks every HLSL artifact at build time.

sdl3_mingw.note: SDL's own MinGW release of the version every other SDL3 profile pins (3.4.16).
